events.title: 🌴 How the hell did we get here?
events.summary: Hey adventurers, welcome back.In our game, you play as a cynical mailman suddenly stuck in a tropical archipelago. And we know what you're thinking:How the hell did he get there?We’re glad you asked, because honestly, we’re still figuring that out too. But let’s start from the beginning: this guy.A game developer in a small Tuscan hill town. Not exactly seaside, but you can almost smell the salt air if the wind’s right. So, It’s 2020. Lockdown. events.title: Tango Rio sets course for Indie Assemble
events.summary: A global event, a digital stage, a tidal wave of indie games (over 1,000 of them!) from 600 studios around the world. And we’re thrilled to announce that The Adventures of Tango Rio will be there too. Amazing, right? Organized by Excaliber, Indie Assemble is a massive celebration of independent games (just like any true adventurer deserves to be). events.title: Welcome to Tango Rio DevLog #0
events.summary: Welcome, Adventurers The Bean Adventure Agency is ready to take you on the bizarre (mis)adventures of Tango Rio — a humble mailman who’s unwillingly shipped off to Polynesia. An epic adventure… Well, not quite. It’s a point-and-click game. But it’s crafted with love, drawn entirely by hand, and we’ll be documenting it step by step in this captain’s log.
